description: This file defines functions for converting between string representations and enum values of AdbMode, a configuration setting related to Android Debug Bridge (ADB) modes, within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

methods.name: StringToAdbMode
methods.description: Converts a string to the corresponding AdbMode enum value, case-insensitive.

methods.name: AdbModeToString
methods.description: Converts an AdbMode enum value to its string representation.
